name: Customer
definition: A fuel-card account holder that buys fuel and other goods at gas stations, identified by customers.CustomerID.
scope: Applies to all customer-level analysis of debit_card_specializing; the customer is the unit that owns cards, monthly consumption and transactions.

name: Customer Segment
definition: The commercial grouping of a customer recorded in customers.Segment, taking the values KAM, LAM and SME.
scope: Customer-level comparative analysis. The database provides no definition of the codes; only their observed ordering by consumption scale is evidenced.

name: Customer Currency
definition: The currency in which a customer's monetary amounts are denominated, recorded in customers.Currency as CZK or EUR.
scope: Governs the interpretation of every monetary value reachable through that customer, in both yearmonth and transactions_1k.

name: Payment Card
definition: A physical fuel card used to pay for a purchase, recorded as transactions_1k.CardID. Each card resolves to exactly one customer, while a customer may hold several cards.
scope: Transaction-level payment-instrument analysis. A card is an instrument of a customer, not an identifier of one.

name: Monthly Consumption
definition: The total monetary value of a customer's purchases in one calendar month, recorded in yearmonth.Consumption.
scope: Customer-month grain, denominated in the customer's currency. Covers 201112 to 201311 with a three-month gap at the end of 2012.

name: Consumption Month
definition: The calendar month a monthly consumption record belongs to, recorded in yearmonth.Date as a six-character year-and-month text value in YYYYMM form.
scope: Time bucketing for monthly consumption only; it is a month label, not a calendar date.

name: Transaction
definition: A single purchase event recorded in transactions_1k and identified by TransactionID, made by one customer with one card at one gas station for one product at one timestamp.
scope: Line-level purchase analysis. transactions_1k holds a 1000-row sample spanning four days, not the complete transaction history.

name: Transaction Paid Amount
definition: The total monetary amount paid for a transaction line, recorded in transactions_1k.Price. It is the line total, not a per-unit price.
scope: Additive only within a single customer currency; summing across CZK and EUR customers mixes units.

name: Transaction Quantity
definition: The quantity of product on a transaction line, recorded in transactions_1k.Amount, expressed in units that depend on the product.
scope: Fuel products record measured volume; goods and services record a count, and zero is a valid recorded value for services.

name: Transaction Date and Time
definition: The calendar date and clock time at which a transaction occurred, recorded as transactions_1k.Date in YYYY-MM-DD form together with transactions_1k.Time in HH:MM:SS form.
scope: Within-day and within-month transaction analysis. Only 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26 is present in the sample.

name: Implied Unit Price
definition: The price paid per unit of quantity on a transaction line, obtained by dividing the line's paid amount by its quantity.
scope: Defined only where the quantity is greater than zero and the unit of that quantity is known, such as litres of fuel.

name: Gas Station
definition: A retail fuel outlet where transactions take place, identified by gasstations.GasStationID and described by its chain, country and market positioning.
scope: Station-level and network-level analysis of the 5716 stations.

name: Station Chain
definition: The commercial chain a gas station belongs to, recorded in gasstations.ChainID. The 5716 stations fall into 233 distinct chains.
scope: Chain-level aggregation of stations. The database stores chain identity as a number only and provides no chain names.

name: Station Segment
definition: The market positioning of a gas station recorded in gasstations.Segment, taking the values Discount, Noname, Other, Premium and Value for money.
scope: Station-level positioning comparisons. It applies to stations, not customers, and is a different concept from customer_segment.

name: Station Country
definition: The country a gas station is located in, recorded in gasstations.Country as CZE or SVK.
scope: Geographic segmentation of the station network. It does not determine the currency of the amounts paid there.

name: Product
definition: An item or service sold at a gas station, identified by products.ProductID and labelled by products.Description.
scope: Product-mix analysis. Description is the only descriptive attribute and no category column exists, so grouping beyond the label text is not available.
